audio_description:
A great golden ring of rotating energy panels blazes in an Esthar chamber.
A robed sorceress figure rises within it.
Two onlookers watch, one a lab-coated scientist.

context.scene_title: An Esthar sorceress-power apparatus activates — a sorceress figure rises within a great golden energy ring as observers (including a lab-coated scientist) look on (Disc 3 endgame).
locations: An Esthar high-technology chamber dominated by a rotating golden ring of energy panels (Dr. Odine's machine / the Crystal Pillar–Lunatic Pandora apparatus)

characters.name: (a sorceress figure)
characters.recognition: A robed figure with pale hair and red streamers stands/rises at the center of the golden energy ring; specific identity not certain from these frames.

characters.name: (observers, incl. a lab-coated scientist)
characters.recognition: Two figures watch from the foreground, one in a long coat (consistent with Dr. Odine, the Esthar scientist).

context.summary: A great golden ring of rotating energy panels blazes around a robed sorceress figure who rises within it, watched by two onlookers — one a lab-coated scientist (suggesting Dr. Odine). An Esthar high-technology apparatus tied to the sorceress-power / Lunatic Pandora plot is being used.
context.context_note: Esthar sorceress-power machinery in the endgame; the exact device and the identity of the central sorceress figure are uncertain — recorded as a best guess.
